title: Spent a year building a free TCG where all 2,512 cards are real species
author: SORAKH2756
selftext:
[https://biomasters.app](https://biomasters.app)

**BioMasters** is a trading card game where every card is a real species and the rules are real ecology. A hawk can only feed on animals lower in the food chain, decomposers turn what falls back into food, and card rarity follows the IUCN Red List.

It's free with no ads and runs in your browser on phone or desktop. No account needed to start. Available in English and Spanish for now.

**What you can play right now**

\- The story, **The First BioMaster**: A recurring dream, a scanner, a talking African Grey parrot named Echo, and a hunt across the world for the Elder Beings. Acts 1 and half of Act 2 (20 chapters) are up and ready. 2nd half has the book/story done but hasn't been implemented in game yet.

\- Battles against the AI and online party games with people in the same room, like Bingo, Card Matching, Bio Compare and Quick Sort.

\- Ranked online

\- 2,512 real species from 211 countries and territories to collect, decks to build, and a biome of your own in the Sanctuary.

**I'd love for you to test it**

Play a few rounds, try to break it, and tell me what's confusing or what goes wrong. Comment here, post on r/BioMasters, or use #bug-reports on Discord.

**AI art**

One of my biggest gripes and main pain points is that in a game that's about educating and learning about nature, it's ironic that most of the art is Ai. There are 2,512 species in the game and each one needs its own art, plus the story scenes. I don't know how to draw or animate and couldn't really commission that many on my own, so the AI art is working art that made the game playable. The goal is art created by the community or commission driven, replacing it card by card. But one issue is that I'm also not really sure what the final physical card will look like so I don't want to waste others time as well. Def need guidance here from seasoned TCG players.

If you're an artist and you'd like to draw a species, or you know someone who might, comment here, message me, or find me on Discord. If you have ideas for how a small free to play game can work with artists, I'm all ears.

My name is **Mr. BioMaster** (Kelsey). Happy to answer anything!

**Playable Link**: [https://biomasters.app](https://biomasters.app)

**Discord**: [https://discord.gg/K5vTyUmXSn](https://discord.gg/K5vTyUmXSn)

comments.author: izstoopid
comments.body:
Interesting project... you'll likely see opposition in the education area because of Ai use. 

In the trailer some things needs to be slowed down like the minigames or some explanations, thats my opinion anyway. 

Besides that good job! Hope to see it grow

replies.author: SORAKH2756
replies.body: Thanks! I'm trying some better transitions. I'm definitely thinking of ways to fix that education/ai angle. Just hoping im bringing alot of value for anyone coming to the website
